title.en: Unit 1203 S2 Ep.7 — Day 6: Siren While Driving

_note: 11/15 새 형식(조회수 실험 1/3): 질문으로 시작 → 10초 안에 답 → 이야기 → 저장용 요약 카드. '민수의 선택' 회상, 점수판, A/B 화면, 다음 화 예고 없음. 6화 투표 결과가 비어 있어 A(차로 마중 간다)를 이야기에 반영. 투표는 캡션·스토리에서만.

beats.ko: 운전 중에 공습경보가 울리면, 절대 계속 달리지 마세요.
beats.en: Never keep driving through an air-raid siren. Here is what to do.
beats.prompt: Seen from outside the front of the same small dark gray car as the reference driving along an empty four-lane city road between gray apartment blocks: through the windshield Minsu (dark brick-red hoodie, big round glasses, no hat) at the steering wheel looking up at the sky, the grandma (gray hair bun, half-moon glasses, muted ochre cardigan, cane) in the passenger seat, a tall pole with a round siren loudspeaker beside the road, the road and sky bright and clearly visible. beats.ko: 도로 오른쪽에 차를 세우고, 차에서 내려 대피합니다.
beats.en: Pull over to the right side of the road, get out, and take cover.
beats.prompt: Wide view of a city road from behind: the same small dark gray car as the reference stopped neatly against the right-hand curb with the driver's door open, a few other plain cars also stopped in a line along the right curb, the middle of the road completely empty, Minsu (dark brick-red hoodie, big round glasses, no hat) and the grandma (gray hair bun, half-moon glasses, muted ochre cardigan, cane) walking away from the car along the sidewalk toward a stairway going down into an underpass. Same simple thick black line stick-figure character design as the reference, drawn quietly and seriously: muted palette (slate gray, dark blue, dark brick red, muted ochre), overcast gray daylight with clear visibility, soft shadows, no exaggerated expressions, no sweat drops, no motion lines, no comic symbols, cinematic vertical composition, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark

beats.ko: 사이렌 6일째. 민수는 멈춰 선 버스에 탄 엄마를 마중 가는 길이었어요. 사이렌이 울리자 민수는 오히려 속도를 올렸죠.
beats.en: Day six. Minsu was driving out to get Mom from her stalled bus, and when the siren rose, he sped up instead.

beats.ko: 할머니가 말했어요. 세워라, 오른쪽에. 차는 두고 몸만 간다.
beats.en: Grandma said, stop the car, on the right, we leave the car and take only ourselves.
beats.prompt: Inside a small car, close view from the driver's side: the grandma (gray hair bun, half-moon glasses, muted ochre cardigan, cane) in the passenger seat calmly pointing with one hand through the windshield toward the right-hand curb, Minsu (dark brick-red hoodie, big round glasses, no hat) at the wheel turning his head to look where she points. beats.en: Minsu parked at the curb and went down into the nearest underpass with Grandma, while Mom's bus was still somewhere up ahead.

beats.ko: 저장해 두세요. 운전 중 공습경보. 하나, 도로 오른쪽이나 공터에 정차. 둘, 차에서 내려 가까운 지하로. 셋, 라디오로 안내 방송 듣기.
beats.en: Save this. If a siren sounds while you are driving: one, pull over to the right or into an open lot. Two, get out and go underground nearby. Three, listen to the radio for instructions.

tts.en: Save this for later, if a siren sounds while you are driving, one, pull over to the right or into an open lot, two, get out and go underground nearby, and three, listen to the radio for instructions.
